1 This petition has been filed for a direction to the 1st respondent to recall the Look-out Circular issued against the petitioner in C.C.No.266 of 2019, pending on the file of Judicial Magistrate No.II (FAC), Panruti.
2.Heard
Mr.K.Balasubramaniam, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.A.Gopinath, learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) appearing on behalf of the respondents.

3.The petitioner along with his father are facing trial before the Court below for offence u/s 498A,
294(b) and 506(i) IPC.
On 17.03.2023, when the case was posted, the petitioner did not appear before the Court and as a result, a Non-Bailable Warrant (NBW) came to be issued by the Court below.
After the issuance of NBW, the 1st respondent issued Look-out Circular against the petitioner (A1).
The petitioner on coming to know of the same, returned back from Qatar and filed an application for recall of NBW and the NBW was recalled by the Court below by an order dated 15.5.2023.
4.The petitioner thereafter participated in the trial and till now, except for PW.3 and PW.7, all the other witnesses have been examined in chief and they have also been cross examined.

It is brought to the notice of this Court that the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3 of 6 matter is posted for the examination of PW.3 and PW.7 on 27.8.2023.
5.This
petition was filed mainly on the ground that the Visa that was given to the petitioner by Qatar is expiring tomorrow.
In view of the same, the petitioner wants to leave to Qatar and extend the Visa.

The petitioner has also given an undertaking that he will be present before the Court below at the time of questioning u/s 313 Cr.PC.
6.Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and also of the fact that the trial is almost complete except for two witnesses and the Visa of the petitioner is expiring tomorrow,
there shall be a direction to the 1st respondent to immediately take steps to recall the Look-out Circular against the petitioner/A1.
The petitioner can leave to Qatar and get the Visa extended.
The petitioner shall be represented before the Court below by the counsel and he shall cross examine the witnesses viz., PW.3 and PW.7, on the same day they are examined in chief.
Thereafter, the petitioner shall come back to India at the stage of questioning u/s 313 Cr.PC.
Thereafter, the petitioner shall stay in India till the final judgment is passed in this case.
7 . T h i s c r i m i n a l o r i g i n a l p e t i t i o n i s d i s p o s e d o f i n t h e a b o v e t e r m s .
T h e https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4 of 6

Court below shall complete the recording of evidence of PW3 and PW.7, by the end of August 2023 and post the matter for questioning u/s 313 Cr.PC.,
during the middle of September 2023.
The petitioner is expected to be present before the Court below at the time of questioning u/s 313 Cr.PC.
Since A.2 has died, the petitioner/A1 alone is now facing the trial.
8.Post this criminal original petition under the caption for reporting compliance on 25.09.2023.
